back_translation: In the year that the Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and captured the city,

at that time the LORD had spoken through Isaiah son of Amoz, saying: "Go, loosen the sackcloth from your waist and take the sandals off your feet." And he did so, walking about stripped naked and barefoot.
Then the LORD said: "Just as Isaiah My servant has walked stripped and barefoot for three years as a sign and an indicator against Egypt and against Cush,
so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the deportees of Cush — both young men and the elderly — stripped and barefoot, with buttocks bared: the disgrace of Egypt.
Then they will be dismayed and ashamed because of Cush, in whom they placed their hope, and because of Egypt, of whom they boasted.

And in that day the inhabitants of this coastland will say: 'Behold, this is what has happened to the object of our hope, to whom we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. How then shall we ourselves escape?'"
